newsitem.title: UK: London shares slump on profit-taking, EMU worries.
newsitem.headline: London shares slump on profit-taking, EMU worries.

text.p: UK shares pushed to their session lows on Friday as some participants locked in profits ahead of a weekend that may decide whether or not the single European currency will go ahead on time.

With some pundits predicting the opposition Socialists will win Sunday's French parliamentary elections, many institutional investors stayed away in case a left victory spooks European bond and share markets on Monday, dealers said.
"We've seen a bit of profit-taking, particularly in the banks," one senior dealer said.
The FTSE 100 leading share index was down 29.2 points at 4,643.1 by 0940 GMT.
